dn-gfl.name: GFL fiber laser cutting machines, 5 × 10 to 6.6 × 20 ft, 3 – 40 kW
dn-gfl.summary: The GFL is Dener's production sheet laser: a gantry on a stress-relieved, one-piece welded frame that moves at 394 ft/min with 1.5 G acceleration, and a shuttle table whose two tables change in 16 to 30 seconds, so the next sheet is loaded while the first is cut. extra_tabs.title: AI Intelligent Air Cutting (optional)

groups.title: Lower running cost
items: Assist gas close to free — no nitrogen or oxygen to buy for most work; Senfeng quotes overall cutting expenses down by up to 92 %

No gas deliveries: no delays, shortages or price swings, even for shops far from a gas supplier

groups.title: Faster, cleaner cuts
items: Carbon steel cuts much faster than with oxygen; thin-sheet throughput up by more than 30 %
Small heat-affected zone and little distortion, so less rework
Edges far less oxidized than oxygen cuts — many parts are welded or fitted straight from the machine, without grinding
Sharp corners without burning and well-formed small holes: a higher yield on complex parts
Little cutting fume, and no high-pressure gas cylinders to store or have inspected every year

groups.title: Everything on one control
items: One screen starts and runs the laser, the air compressor and the dust collector

groups.title: Control and AI
items: Senfeng-exclusive BOCHU FSCUT8000 control, preloaded with the full 6 – 60 kW air-cutting process database

Cuts carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum and brass
